🌟 portracker | JavaScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: Real-time network port and service discovery and monitoring for self-hosted environments.
✨ Key Features: • Automatic Port Discovery • Platform-Specific Collectors (Docker, TrueNAS) • Internal Port Detection • Lightweight & Self-Contained (SQLite) • Peer-to-Peer Monitoring
📖 Summary: Portracker is an open-source, self-hosted tool that automatically discovers and monitors network ports and services across your systems. It provides a real-time, accurate map of your network, preventing manual tracking and deployment issues.
